thread:
tom.k: Quick question  for promotions that include sensitive items (equity refresh, severance changes, or manager disciplinary context), what's the right way to tag/store evidence so access is restricted but auditability remains?

julia_p: short answer: put sensitive docs in the Private/PromoSensitive folder and reference the file link in the public evidence packet. Do not paste sensitive text into the public packet.

liam_hr: to add: managers must add a one-line "sensitivity reason" in the intake form (options: equity, legal, investigation, other) so People Ops can set ACLs. We also require an attestation that the manager has informed any affected employee(s) about what will be stored.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Promo Evidence Retention & Access policy v1.5 requires raw sensitive docs to be retained in the secure folder with restricted access. Audit logs are kept for 7 years. See: https://redwoodintra/confluence/promotions/evidence-access

Sophia_comp: operational detail: for comp committee review we accept a sanitized summary (2-3 bullet points) in the public packet and the raw files in Private/PromoSensitive. The committee reviewers will get temporary read access via People Ops if needed.

tom.k: how should managers name files to make audits easy to scan? any naming convention?

julia_p: yes  use this pattern: "YYYYMMDD_candidate-lastname_sensitive-<reason>_<uploaderInitials>" and for public excerpts: "YYYYMMDD_candidate-lastname_excerpt_<uploaderInitials>". Put both links in the intake form.

liam_hr: also require a short "who/why" note in the intake: who requested the redaction or flagged sensitivity, and a 1-line reason. That note is searchable in People Ops logs.

tom.k: can we automate temporary reviewer access instead of manual ACLs? slows things down during tight cutovers.

people-ops-bot: Action created: /task create "Auto-provision read access for comp committee on sensitive promo folders" assigned to julia_p, due 2026-06-15.

julia_p: I'll build the auto-provision workflow. For immediate cases, ping People Ops in the intake and we'll grant time-limited access (typically 72 hours).

Sophia_comp: one practical caution  avoid including identifying PII in excerpts. If legal or privacy flags appear, route to Legal before committee review.

liam_hr: final manager-facing blurb to paste in promo threads: "If the promo involves sensitive materials (equity, legal, investigation), upload raw docs to Private/PromoSensitive, add the sensitivity reason in the intake, and include a 2-line sanitized excerpt in the public packet. People Ops will handle ACLs and temporary reviewer access; missing sensitivity flags may delay processing."

tom.k: perfect, will add to the manager guidance doc. Closing thread once julia creates the auto-provision action. :white_check_mark:
